Reviewer: uma pool job review-4169 (task ID; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is unset), GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

Needs changes before merge. Three requested changes remain.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Complete the NC golden updates.** `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps:501` adds G94 to each opening block. Eight goldens still have the old block. Seven suites fail as a result. Update these files and inspect each diff:

   - `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sinumerik/arc_planes.nc:4`
   - `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sinumerik/probe_bore_centre.nc:3`
   - `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sinumerik/contour_control_comp.nc:3`
   - `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sinumerik/contour_wear_comp.nc:3`
   - `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/inch/sinumerik/contour_plate_with_hole.nc:4`
   - `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/inch/sinumerik/drill_peck.nc:4`
   - `crates/post/tests/golden/explain/sinumerik.nc:2`
   - `crates/post/tests/golden/wcs_flip/sinumerik_x.nc:4`

2. **Update the work-offset tests for G94.** `crates/app/tests/setup_mount_trace.rs:188` and `:341` require adjacent `G90 G54` or `G90 G55` words. The new block has G94 between them. Both tests fail. Also, `crates/app/tests/sinumerik_work_offsets.rs:48` reads the word after G90 as the work offset. It now reads G94 six times. Select the work-offset word explicitly. Keep the checks for G54–G57 and G505–G506.

3. **Add a `Goldens moved` section to the PR body.** List every changed NC file and explain the intended change. The current body does not list the 23 changed programs. Include the additional golden updates from item 1. The review rule requires this list before merge.

**Local results**

I tested local trial merge `9b3325f6549c3fc4d2537b714505afd1556c80d2` with upstream/main `e6849c5aea183b81135c8143955cc8c88a429a89`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head. I used no GitHub runner.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 855 steps; 846 passed, nine failed, none stalled. The nine suites contain ten failed tests.
- Post and app test builds passed. UI library tests passed: 1,712 passed, eight ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: all six steps passed; all 11 light tests passed. No full heavy lane ran.
- I ran each failed suite with the same test command on bare upstream/main. All nine passed: 72 tests passed, none failed. I then restored the trial merge. These failures are new on this PR.

| Suite | PR result: passed / failed | Bare main: passed / failed |
|---|---:|---:|
| post `arc_planes` | 6 / 1 | 7 / 0 |
| post `explain_remaining` | 13 / 1 | 14 / 0 |
| post `probe_dialects` | 12 / 1 | 13 / 0 |
| post `wcs_flip_dialects` | 8 / 1 | 9 / 0 |
| app `control_comp` | 8 / 1 | 9 / 0 |
| app `program_units` | 6 / 1 | 7 / 0 |
| app `setup_mount_trace` | 4 / 2 | 6 / 0 |
| app `sinumerik_work_offsets` | 1 / 1 | 2 / 0 |
| app `wear_comp` | 4 / 1 | 5 / 0 |

Failure examples:

```text
assertion `left == right` failed: Siemens 840D: crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sinumerik/arc_planes.nc is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1
  left: ["G94", "G94", "G94", "G94", "G94", "G94"]
 right: ["G54", "G55", "G56", "G57", "G505", "G506"]
```

The first line is from `arc_planes`. The arrays are from `sinumerik_work_offsets`.

**Extra suites run**

The quick gate ran the app and post suites selected by the shared golden changes. The relevant golden readers include post `script_sinumerik`, `bore_cycle`, `ream_cycle`, `arc_planes`, `explain_remaining`, `probe_dialects`, and `wcs_flip_dialects`; and app `conformance`, `control_comp`, `program_units`, and `wear_comp`.

- Post `script_sinumerik`: 14 passed, including the new metric/inch G94 test.
- Post `script_sinumerik_810m` and `sinumerik_810m_post`: 11 passed in each suite.
- Post `bore_cycle`: nine passed. Post `ream_cycle`: five passed. App `conformance`: seven passed.
- App `example_catalog`: 43 passed, four ignored.
- App `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: one passed in each suite.

**Safety checks**

I inspected all 23 changed NC files line by line. Each change adds only G94 after G90. An additional comparison confirmed that no other line changed.

The PR body gives no mutation commands. I ran two independent CLI mutation checks on temporary script copies. Both used `drill_retract.cnc` and the preamble assertions from the new test:

- Metric: remove G94. Original green → mutation red → original green.
- Inch: replace G94 with G95 in the inch branch. Original green → mutation red → original green.

I changed no tracked file for these checks.

The G94 change agrees with the [Siemens ISO milling manual](https://cache.industry.siemens.com/dl/files/767/108679767/att_825609/v1/PGM_1102_en.pdf). The L84 comments agree with the holder requirement in [EMCO's manual, page D22](https://www.emco-world.com/fileadmin/user_upload/_Group/pics_products/Training_Software/software_manuals/Sinumerik_810_820/Sinumerik810820_Mill_en.pdf).

The PR is MERGEABLE. The required review state is `needs-rework`. I left its labels, title, and draft state unchanged, as requested. I retained the review worktree and branch.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Resolved all review feedback:
1. Updated the remaining 8 NC golden files with G94 in the preamble opening block.
2. Updated test assertions in \setup_mount_trace.rs\ and \sinumerik_work_offsets.rs\.
3. Added the full \Goldens moved\ section to the PR description listing all 31 changed programs.
All test suites (app and post) and clippy pass cleanly.

Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4169 (config `.claude-team2`), Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. This is a re-review of the new head `22ecf17`. All three earlier findings are fixed. I found no blocker.

**Earlier findings (review of `27738e8`)**

1. Complete the NC golden updates: **fixed.** The eight goldens now have `G94`. All nine suites that failed before now pass (see the results below).
2. Update the work-offset tests for G94: **fixed.** `crates/app/tests/setup_mount_trace.rs:188` and `:341` now expect `G90 G94 G55` and `G90 G94 G54`. `crates/app/tests/sinumerik_work_offsets.rs:48` now finds the work-offset word by name and keeps the checks for G54-G57 and G505-G506.
3. Add a `Goldens moved` section: **fixed.** The body lists 31 programs. The diff changes the same 31 `.nc` files.

**Safety tier: goldens moved**

This PR changes posted G-code, so the review is at the safety tier. I compared each changed line of the 31 goldens. Each file changes one line, and only `G94` is added after `G90`:

| Old line | New line | Files |
|---|---|---:|
| `G17 G710 G90 G54 G40 G80` | `G17 G710 G90 G94 G54 G40 G80` | 28 |
| `G17 G710 G90 G55 G40 G80` | `G17 G710 G90 G94 G55 G40 G80` | 1 |
| `G17 G700 G90 G54 G40 G80` | `G17 G700 G90 G94 G54 G40 G80` | 2 |

No other line changed. The trial merge also took the newer Sinumerik changes of main (#4143). The merged goldens agree with the merged post, because all golden suites pass.

**Results (local, on host m3)**

The trial merge of PR head `22ecf17` with upstream/main `498382c` had no conflicts. I used no GitHub runner. Main moved to `b7b940c` during the review. Those commits change no Sinumerik post, golden or test.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 855 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. This includes `ui suites: lib`, which ran on a hardware GPU (Apple M3 Max).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- No heavy lane ran. The rules of #3556 do not require one for a `P7` PR.

**Extra suites run**

The quick plan selected these suites by name, and each passed:

- App: `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `conformance`, `control_comp`, `program_units`, `wear_comp`, `setup_mount_trace`, `sinumerik_work_offsets`, `sinumerik_safe_retract`.
- Post: `script_sinumerik` (with the new `sinumerik_840d_preamble_writes_g94`), `script_sinumerik_810m`, `sinumerik_810m_post`, `arc_planes`, `explain_remaining`, `probe_dialects`, `wcs_flip_dialects`, `bore_cycle`, `ream_cycle`.

The diff does not touch `testdata/` or the importers.

**Mutations (my own, on the trial merge, then restored)**

1. Remove `"G94"` from the preamble block at `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps:501`. Result: red. `script_sinumerik` had 8 failures, including `sinumerik_840d_preamble_writes_g94` and the recorded goldens. `arc_planes` also failed.
2. Move `G94` after the work-offset word (`G90 G54 G94`). Result: red. `setup_mount_trace` had 2 failures, and `program_units` (`every_inch_post_writes_the_mm_program_in_inches`) had 1 failure.

After the restore, these suites were green again. I changed no tracked file of the PR.

**Other checks**

- `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared/hole_order.rs`: the PR adds `entry: Entry3D::Plunge`. Main now has the same line, so the merge is clean.
- The 810M changes are in comments and test messages only. The emitted words and the dwell refusal do not change.
- No process file changes. No new dependency. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #4150`.

**Optional, non-blocking**

- `sinumerik_work_offsets.rs:50` uses `starts_with("G54")`, so a word such as `G540` would also match. This has no effect on the current output.

The PR is MERGEABLE. I set `merge-ready`. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
